_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco HyperFlex, 14 Sep 2026. Nodes by model (HX220c, HX225c, HX240c, HX245c; hybrid, All Flash HXAF and All NVMe variants of one model sit together), Edge and Express, compute-only nodes, fabric interconnects and bundles; a component whose SKU names a node platform (HX-RIS-2A-240M5, CBL-SATA-C220M6) sits with that node, any other HX- component in 'HyperFlex shared parts'. Compute-only nodes (HX-C220 / HX-C240 / HX-C480 / HX-B200) come first: their SKUs carry the same platform tokens. No role axis.

series.series: HyperFlex compute-only nodes (C220 / C240 / C480 / B200)
